kind: Independent read-only Linux adapter diagnostics amendment review
qualifications: No actual runsc, cgroup, watchdog, generated code or Linux privileged operation executed by this review
Per-command byte caps do not imply aggregate retention limits across unlimited operator reconciliation retries
Actual resource, mount, UID/capability, cgroup membership/termination and numerical gates remain open
reviewed_boundaries: Fixed job/stage paths and active journal lease before any diagnostic retention
Private0700 directories and create-only0400 bytes; UUID filenames do not overwrite an earlier stage receipt
Create transport stdout body omitted; hash/size retained without duplicating guest outputs
Other stdout and runtime stderr use fixed byte prefixes with captured and retained hashes/sizes and explicit truncation
Diagnostic write failure denies publication; delete failure still enters final whole-cgroup kill/empty readback
Watchdog/launcher scoped FDs, parent/cancel/deadline fences and liveness handshake are unchanged by diagnostics
Diagnostic bytes/hashes are private evidence, never execution or release authority
